name: Perception, Autonomy, and Intelligent Robotics Systems Lab
tagline: Perception, representation and learning for robots that operate in the real world.

affiliation.institution: University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University

directions.title: Active & semantic SLAM
directions.summary: Building meaningful representations of the world for autonomous robots.
directions.description: Building meaningful representations of the world for autonomous robots. Our research spans probabilistic semantic mapping, visual SLAM under challenging conditions, and active exploration with UAVs.

directions.title: Robot learning & interaction
directions.summary: Learning robot behavior from observations, demonstrations and interaction.
directions.description: Learning robot behavior from observations, demonstrations and interaction. We investigate imitation learning, reinforcement learning and the use of vision-language models for robotic manipulation and human–robot interaction.

directions.title: Reliable localization & navigation
directions.description: Connecting perception with safe decisions. We work on semantic-aware path planning, multisensor fusion, and motion prediction for navigation around people and in challenging environments.

directions.title: Robot vision & industrial perception
directions.summary: Turning visual observations into useful information for robotics and inspection.
directions.description: Turning visual observations into useful information for robotics and inspection. Applications include monocular 3D object localization and super-resolution methods for detecting tiny defects on printed circuit boards.

research_interests: We are also interested in lifelong SLAM, robot dynamics learning, model-based reinforcement learning and learning from demonstration. Modeling uncertainty in map representations and robot dynamics is central to our interests in safe, active planning and control.

members.name: Thanh Nguyen Canh
members.bio: Thanh Nguyen Canh is a lecturer in the Robotics Department at the University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University (VNU-UET), and a Ph.D. candidate at the Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (JAIST), working on 3D active semantic SLAM, robot perception, navigation and learning.

student_awards.title: Student Research Competition, VNU-University of Engineering and Technology

funded_projects.title: SOLARIS
funded_projects.description: Research on drone teams for monitoring solar panels and detecting defects and faults, with Prof. Antonio Sgorbissa at RICE Lab, DIBRIS, University of Genoa.
funded_projects.role: Thanh Nguyen Canh, visiting researcher, University of Genoa

research_projects.title: Semantic Active SLAM
research_projects.description: Semantic-aware mapping and active exploration for UAVs, with research on robust visual SLAM, data association and Gaussian splatting.

research_projects.title: Humanoid Robot Interaction & Social Navigation
research_projects.description: Multi-robot collaboration, humanoid perception and interaction using vision-language and large language models, with navigation in crowded environments.

research_projects.title: Delibot — Humanoid Robotics
research_projects.description: Design and fabrication of a dual-arm service robot, visual 3D localization from 2D estimates and obstacle avoidance using multisensor fusion.

positions.title: Master's students
positions.text: Students who want to do thesis research in SLAM, robot learning or autonomous navigation. Contact us with your research interests before you apply.

positions.title: Undergraduate researchers
positions.text: VNU-UET undergraduates can join ongoing projects, co-author papers and take part in the Student Research Competition.

positions.title: Visiting students & collaborators
positions.text: Students and researchers at other institutions are welcome to collaborate with us on a clearly scoped research project.
